title: Realised
description:
One FIFO-matched realised gain: a slice of a sell against a single lot. A sell spanning two lots produces two of these. DERIVED, NEVER STORED. Source of truth: docs/ENGINE_SPEC.md section 3.

The MVP computes and displays realised gains. It does NOT produce a tax return: Section 112A grandfathering, bonus stripping and demerger cost ratios are a later phase (docs/TAX_ENGINE.md).

quantity.description: Quantity consumed from this particular lot, not the whole sell.

cost_stt.description: STT embedded in `cost` for this slice, drawn from the acquiring lot's own STT-per-unit. `cost` itself is UNCHANGED by this field -- it stays net of ALL charges including STT, for Phase 1's real-cash realised-P/L display. app.engine.realised.tax_cost = cost - cost_stt is the Section-48-compliant tax figure.

proceeds_stt.description: STT already subtracted out of `proceeds` for this slice, computed once per disposal transaction. `proceeds` itself is UNCHANGED. app.engine.realised.tax_proceeds = proceeds + proceeds_stt adds it back, since Section 48 disallows netting sale-side STT out of full value of consideration.

term.description: LONG when holding_days exceeds the threshold for the asset class, otherwise SHORT. The threshold lives in schema/asset_classes.json as long_term_days (365 for EQ), never hardcoded, because it differs by asset and changes with the annual budget.
